listing.name: SSX 3 (Xbox, PAL) (SSX3-Recomp (bertibertig))
listing.summary: An experimental SSX 3 Linux x86-64 racing port. The Windows x86-64 preview crashes while loading races and is explicitly unplayable; Wine/Proton testing does not establish native Windows play. macOS work has not started. Supply your own PAL/Europe original-Xbox build dated 2003-09-19, title 4541003C, with English/French/German/Spanish. The installer accepts a full ISO, trimmed XISO or complete extracted tree into game_files/. The original XBE SHA-1 is ba876cc11ad38650eac9831b1c7f8c4dbf7c5ba9; its documented region/media-free patched form is 409141774025fce02ab4743d1e669d35bb1d190e. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
